meta.name: market-segments
meta.description: Identify 3-5 potential customer segments with demographics, JTBD, and product fit analysis. Use when exploring market segments, identifying target audiences, evaluating new markets, or learning how to segment a market.

copy.tagline: 识别潜在客户群体并分析产品契合度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析客户群体并找到产品市场契合点。
copy.tagline_en: Identify potential customer segments and analyze product fit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze customer segments and find product-market fit.

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的产品，找出 3-5 个不同的客户群体，并描述每个群体的特征、需求、痛点以及你的产品如何满足他们。
howto.when: 当你询问市场细分、目标受众、新市场评估或如何划分市场时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析智能手表的潜在客户群体。
say.note: Claude 会输出 3-5 个细分市场及其详细分析。

say.text: 我的产品是线上课程平台，请找出目标用户群。
say.note: Claude 会生成客户细分报告。

howto.what_en: Claude will analyze your product, identify 3-5 distinct customer segments, and describe each segment's demographics, jobs-to-be-done, pain points, and product fit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about market segments, target audiences, new market evaluation, or how to segment a market.

say_en.text: Analyze potential customer segments for smartwatches.
say_en.note: Claude will output 3-5 segments with detailed analysis.

say_en.text: My product is an online course platform. Find target user groups.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a customer segmentation report.
